note: Manual fixes to the monthly discovery of cities' and counties' public-place layers (placepacks/directories/city_facilities.py). add: layers the catalogues miss, each {"platform": "arcgis", "url": "https://.../FeatureServer/0", "title", "publisher"} or {"platform": "socrata", "domain", "dataset", "title", "publisher"} (fields and state are found by the usual one-record check unless given). skip: {layer id or a part of its address: why} for layers that are wrong (not public places, a duplicate copy, a people list). fields: {layer id: {"name": field, "phone": field, ...}} to correct the automatic field mapping. Layer ids are in the month's layers-city-facilities.json in the release city-facilities.
